brief:
Israeli forces conducted widespread dawn raids across the occupied West Bank on Thursday, IMEMC News reported. The military operations involved invasions of multiple homes, property damage, and the abduction of Palestinians across several governorates in the northern region of the occupied territory.

The incursions resulted in ransacked residences and detained Palestinians, though specific numbers of those abducted and the exact locations of individual raids were not immediately detailed in early reports of the operation. The raids are part of a pattern of military activity in the West Bank that has continued throughout the week.
